schema_notes: gold_category is one of BIOMED, CALCULATION, GENERAL — matches the Category enum in hello_langgraph.py.
trap_class groups questions by what kind of misroute they're designed to surface; it is not read by the classifier, only used for the confusion/accuracy breakdown in eval_classification.py.

off_corpus_biomed convention: an in-domain biomedical question about a paper NOT in the ai-research-assistant corpus is labeled BIOMED, not GENERAL. classify_question judges topical intent, not corpus coverage — the agent's retry loop (ADR-002) is what handles a BIOMED question the RAG service can't actually answer. Labeling these GENERAL would score the classifier against information it structurally cannot have (corpus contents).
Evaluated by calling classify_question directly (see eval_classification.py) — this bypasses condense_question by design; conversational reference resolution is out of scope for this issue.

q28 is a real resolved_question captured from a live demo run (turn 3 of the 2026-08-21 demo, condensed from 'And what's that spring percentage increase times 3, rounded to 1 decimal place?'), not hand-written. Included because it's a genuine production instance of the calculation_in_biomed_clothing trap that classify_question resolved correctly at the time — a useful regression anchor.
